categories.content: Cookie Launchpad is a token sale platform operated by Cookie DAO that allocates participation opportunities in three pools: one for top users ranked by on-chain and social engagement ('capital mindshare' via Cookie Snaps), one for $COOKIE token stakers in higher tiers, and a public first-come-first-served pool.

categories.name: LSDFi
categories.content: Liquid Staking Derivatives Finance (LSDFi) combines the principles of liquid staking derivatives with traditional DeFi applications to offer enhanced financial opportunities and flexibility to cryptocurrency users.

categories.name: Avalanche L1
categories.content: Avalanche L1 are specialized sets of validators on Avalanche that allow the creation of customized independent networks with specific rules and governance to enable scalable and tailored blockchain solutions for various applications.
